references.text: Refers to the place that the Lord will choose for his name to dwell there, the same concept of the chosen place of worship
The immediate context explaining why the money was to be used - when the journey is too long to carry the tithe
The continuation explaining what the money was to be used for upon arriving at the chosen place
Another example of the command to travel to the place the Lord chooses for religious celebration
The same wording about going to the place that the Lord your God will choose for his name to dwell there
The fulfillment of the promise regarding the chosen place - Jerusalem and the temple that the Lord chose
